name: Draenethyst Crystals
summary: At the Harborage, Magtoor asks you to recover six draenethyst crystals stolen from the Fallow Sanctuary. Sacred to his people, the crystals are bound to their fear of losing their way.

sections.title: The Lost Ones
sections.body: The lost ones of the Fallow Sanctuary resemble Magtoor's people. The journey to Azeroth drove them mad. Once brethren, they now dwell in the Sanctuary to the east, where they seize or kill anyone who strays close. They have also stolen draenethyst crystals, sacred to Magtoor's people.

sections.title: Without the Crystals
sections.body: Magtoor's people lack the strength to enter the Fallow Sanctuary and reclaim the draenethyst among its huts and campfires. Without the crystals, they fear they too may lose their way. So Magtoor asks you to bring back six.

faq.q: Who is asking for the draenethyst crystals?
faq.answer: Magtoor asks for the crystals from the Harborage.

faq.q: Why are the draenethyst crystals important to Magtoor?
faq.answer: The draenethyst crystals are sacred to Magtoor's people. Without them, Magtoor fears they too may lose their way.
The lost ones of the Fallow Sanctuary took the crystals. They were once Magtoor's brethren, until the rigors of the journey to Azeroth drove them mad.

faq.q: Where can the crystals be found?
faq.answer: You can find the crystals among the huts and campfires of the Fallow Sanctuary, to the east.

faq.q: Why can't Magtoor's people retrieve them themselves?
faq.answer: Magtoor's people lack the strength to enter the Sanctuary and take the crystals back.
